---
name: Port request
about: Request (or propose) Fadetouched for another app
title: "[port] "
labels: port
---

**App**
Which app, and a link to its theme/color-scheme format docs.

**Format**
What the theme file looks like (JSON, TOML, YAML, plist, and so on) and where it lives.

**Notes**
Anything unusual about how it maps colors (does it support alpha? separate
bright ANSI? semantic tokens?).

Adding a port is a one-time role mapping under `scripts/ports/` if you'd like to add it yourself.
